factor_modifiers.description: Doors taller than standard 7ft increase area, handling, and edge work.
factor_modifiers.notes: Apply based on door size; 8' doors typically at higher end.

factor_modifiers.description: Louvered geometry reduces productivity and increases defect correction likelihood.
factor_modifiers.notes: At QL-5 consider an authorization threshold or not-to-exceed pattern due to labor uncertainty.

factor_modifiers.description: Occupied spaces require more protection/containment and careful cleanup.

quality_effects.description: Standard finish: base rounds, limited between-coat sanding as needed, typical single inspection + corrections.
quality_effects.notes: QL-3 may omit between-coat sanding unless defects require.

quality_effects.description: Enhanced finish: more frequent between-coat sanding and re-inspection; higher-performing enamel system.
quality_effects.notes: Typically adds inspection pass 2 and more consistent sanding between coats.

quality_effects.description: Premium finish: strict inspection discipline and potential optional clear coat; higher rework sensitivity and conservative assumptions.
quality_effects.notes: Adds final inspection and expects tighter defect correction.

assumptions: Rates are placeholders for workflow demonstration and must be field-calibrated before approval.
Rates are expressed per door side (EA) for door-side tasks unless noted.
risks: Louvers may exceed estimate without explicit authorization due to geometry-driven labor and rework.
Spraying in occupied spaces increases risk without proper containment.
validation_plan: Field-calibrate per-door-side times for slab/panel/french/bifold/louvered across QL-3/4/5.
Track correction time variance to refine defect correction rates and louver multipliers.
Confirm material usage assumptions (waste factors and consumables) with real job logs.
